$comment: COLLECTIONS-PROTOCOL-AND-PRODUCT-001 Part B — authoritative, target-aware environment identity for the controlled-migration control plane. The ENVIRONMENT is selected EXPLICITLY by name (SANDBOX|LIVE); it is NEVER inferred from a database name. The controller cross-checks the connected database against `database` here and fail-closes on any mismatch, so an accidental Sandbox credential can never drive a LIVE apply and vice-versa. No secrets live here — only non-secret identity and policy. Secret material is referenced by name (`*_ref`) and resolved at run time from the environment's own secret store.

secret_refs.$comment: Resolved from the LIVE secret store at run time; NEVER embedded here. Names only.

financial_live_gate.$comment: The platform-wide Financial LIVE gate is INDEPENDENT of Collections and stays fail-closed. Deploying the Collections schema/routes to LIVE does NOT open real-money movement — that is gated separately and remains NOT_READY here.

LIVE_DISPOSABLE.$comment: A throwaway Live-SHAPED substrate for autonomous validation ONLY. Same governance policy as LIVE (dual-control, maintenance window, verified backup), a disposable database, provisioned=false so it can never be mistaken for real Live. Used by live-foundation-disposable-e2e.sh to prove the whole governed process end-to-end without touching any real environment.
